Title: Traversal Using Relays Around NAT (TURN) is now in public preview for Azure Communication Services

Body.Content:
Traversal Using Relays Around NAT (TURN) protocol support is now available for voice or video calling built with Azure Communication Services. These services can be used to allow real-time communication between web or mobile applications built with open-source WebRTC, when endpoints are behind NAT or firewalls that may be preventing a successful connection.
